blockers.issue: The textbook supports (*|*) as a primitive distinction form and A|E as a canonical dominant-domain realization, but does not define A|E as a closure result of (*|*) under relational necessity.
blockers.repair: State the relation as a provisional hypothesis and preserve the governed projection route A|E -> Pi_D(A|E) -> D(*|*).

blockers.issue: Relational necessity is asserted as if it forces complementary roles, but no necessity theorem or axiom is currently registered.
blockers.repair: Keep it as an open conjecture until typed conditions and counterexamples are specified.

blockers.issue: Alignment is not a registered typed operator/state with invariants.
blockers.repair: Define orientation, stabilization, alignment, and closure as distinct typed notions.

blockers.issue: Relational basins without intrinsic identity may conflict with the governed state S as a locally addressable aspect-condition carrying residue and admissibility context.
blockers.repair: Use pre-realization unresolved conditions, not identity-free ontological entities.

blockers.issue: The proposed pipeline includes closed RT atom and typed domain projection, but the prior induction review left their closure, operand, and codomain obligations open.
blockers.repair: Reference the open Atom_RT/Pi_Euclid obligations and do not treat those stages as defined.

notation_conflicts.detail: Textbook calls it a primitive distinction form, while RT_core remains the unique primitive calculus; do not call (*|*) an independent ontological primitive.
Existing text treats A|E as canonical dominant-domain realization and Pi_D(A|E) as its projection route.
Must not be used as a formal operator or theorem predicate until typed.
A proposed principle, not a current axiom or derived theorem.

accepted_claims: The packet preserves the whole-expression and monist orientation of the framework.
The packet is consistent with treating | as a primitive distinction/admissibility-related separator rather than division or ratio.
The packet is directionally consistent with orientation, stabilization, projection, and geometry-not-primitive constraints.
The packet correctly keeps the claim at C1 provisional level and disclaims formal proof and unique realization.
rejected_claims: AX-RN-001 cannot be promoted as an independent primitive ontology because RT_core remains the unique primitive calculus.
AX-RN-002 is not accepted as a necessity axiom or theorem without formal admissibility conditions.
AX-RN-003 is not accepted as a defined realization law; current text gives the governed Pi_D projection route, not this closure equation.
Identity-as-emergent is not established as a general framework law.
required_repairs: Recast admissibility window as a provisional interpretation of the existing bar semantics, not a new primitive function.
Separate distinction, admissibility, orientation, alignment, stabilization, closure, and projection.
Define alignment with type, domain, codomain, invariants, and failure states.
Define relational necessity as a candidate axiom or theorem obligation with countermodels.
Align A|E -> Pi_D(A|E) -> D(*|*) with the current textbook before proposing any alternative direction.
Carry forward unresolved Atom_RT, ordinal operand, and Pi_Euclid obligations.

proposed_patch.target_anchor: After the existing whole-expression/typed projection material in Section 1.2.2B, before metric bridge material.
